title: AuthorityBench: Benchmarking LLM Authority Perception for Reliable Retrieval-Augmented Generation
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking 'authority perception' in LLMs—the ability to discern the credibility of information sources based on structural or popularity-based proxies. It includes an analysis of 'scoring bias' (the tendency to overestimate low-authority sources), but it does not evaluate religious beliefs, morals, or ethical frameworks.
